question: What will be the percentage change in the British pound to US dollar exchange rate (GBPUSD=X on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-09-03 to the close on 2026-09-12?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-12 / close on 2026-09-03 - 1), using daily closes of GBPUSD=X on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-12, the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't get onto Yahoo Finance or two of the history pages because the proxy refused the connection. What follows comes from search-result summaries of secondary data sites, so it is useful but not checked against the primary source.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question settles on the Yahoo Finance daily closes for GBPUSD=X. When I tried the [Yahoo history page](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GBPUSD=X/history/) the proxy refused the connection, so I could not read the Yahoo close for 2026-09-03 myself.
- 2026-09-03: Pound Sterling Live shows a close of about **1.3514**, with a range of 1.3480 to 1.3548. The Bank of England reference rate that day was 1.3518. [PSL history](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/GBP-USD-2026), [BoE reference rates](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/bank-of-england-spot/historical-spot-exchange-rates/gbp/gbp-to-usd-2026)
- 2026-09-04: Pound Sterling Live shows open 1.3525, high 1.3549, low 1.3485, close **1.3517**. The BoE reference rate was 1.3515. [PSL history](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/GBP-USD-2026)
- Yahoo's "close" for FX is a snapshot taken at a different time from Pound Sterling Live's, so the Yahoo figure may differ by about 0.1 to 0.3%.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Measured from the 3 September close, the pair was roughly flat (about +0.02%) at the close on 2026-09-04, based on Pound Sterling Live data.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-04: The US August jobs report came out. One undated broker note (PU Prime) says payrolls were 162k against a 56k consensus and that this "revived" the dollar. I could not confirm that the note refers to 2026. [Finance Magnates/PU Prime](https://directory.financemagnates.com/forex-brokers/pu-prime/us-jobs-shock-revives-the-dollarbut-inflation-holds-the-final-vote/)
- 2026-09-03: The UK 10-year gilt yield hit 5.294% on Wednesday 2 September, its highest since August 2007, then eased toward 5.13% on Thursday. Worries about UK borrowing costs weighed on sterling. [CurrencyNews](https://www.currencynews.co.uk/forecast/20260903-47093_british-pound-to-euro-forecast-gilt-yield-surge-threatens-1-16.html), [ExchangeRates.org.uk](https://www.exchangerates.org.uk/news/47074/2026-09-03-pound-to-euro-forecast-rising-gilt-yields-put-1-16-under-pressure.html)
- 2026-09-03: GBP/USD climbed back above 1.35 as better risk appetite reduced demand for the dollar as a safe haven. [CentralFX](https://centralfx.co.uk/gbpusd-september-overview-october-outlook-2026/)
- 2026-09-02: A morning brief put the UK 10-year yield at 5.28% and Bank Rate at 3.75%, and flagged Strait of Hormuz risk and a rally in gold. [Samuel & Co](https://www.samuelandcotrading.com/morning-market-brief-2-september-2026-hormuz-yields-gold/)
- Around 2026-09-02/03: A headline describes GBP/USD as "near a 3-month low" after a UK gilt auction cleared at 5.383%. [EBC](https://www.ebc.com/forex/gbp-usd-uk-gilt-auction-5-383-yield)
- 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-04: The pair eased from 1.3583 to about 1.353 over this period (figures from a Cambridge Currencies weekly piece). [Cambridge Currencies](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/weekly-currency-forecast-7-september-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- GBP/USD usually moves about 0.4 to 0.5% a day. Over six trading days that works out to a standard deviation of roughly 1.0 to 1.2%. In calm weeks, moves of ±0.5% are common. Moves above ±2% in a week are rare, perhaps 5 to 10% of weeks, and tend to happen around UK fiscal or gilt stress.
- Recent trend: a mild drift lower from late August (about 1.358) to about 1.351, alongside the gilt sell-off.
- Both the question's range (-3% to +4%) and the realized volatility point to a distribution centred near zero, with fatter tails because of the gilt-market stress.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Robinhood lists an event contract on the pound-to-dollar rate for 2026-09-04, but I could not see any prices for a contract dated 11 or 12 September. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/fx/events/pound-sterling-to-us-dollar-exchange-rate-september-4-2026-sep-04-2026/)
- Cambridge Currencies gives an expected range of 1.3350 to 1.3650 for the week of 7 to 11 September. I couldn't confirm it was published by 2026-09-05. [Cambridge Currencies](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/weekly-currency-forecast-7-september-2026/)
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this exact question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The week of 7 to 11 September: UK July GDP and other monthly data, likely around 10 or 11 September (exact date not confirmed).
- 2026-09-10 (Thursday): ECB decision. Cambridge Currencies says a rate hike is expected. [Cambridge Currencies](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/weekly-currency-forecast-7-september-2026/)
- 2026-09-11 (Friday): US August CPI. Cambridge Currencies calls it the last major inflation print before the Fed's 16 September decision, and it falls on the likely resolution day. [Cambridge Currencies](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/weekly-currency-forecast-7-september-2026/)
- Throughout the week: further UK gilt auctions and yield moves, and Middle East or Strait of Hormuz risk affecting demand for the dollar as a safe haven.
- Gaps: I could not get a primary Yahoo value, the BLS-confirmed 2026 payrolls figure, or confirmed ONS release dates.
